messages:
lucas: Hola team — quick onboarding questions for Spain hire. My start was 4/07. Portal shows "pending" for health and I didn't see partner coverage option. Do family members get covered immediately or after docs? Also submitted relocation receipts yesterday 04/10 024  will that appear on my 4/30 pay or as a separate reimbursement?

alejandra-peopleops: welcome, Lucas! :wave: short answers: for Spain (EOR), public health coordination depends on Seguridad Social registration. if SS number is assigned on or before your start, coverage usually effective immediately. partner/dependent coverage requires civil registry/marriage cert + NIE/address proof. once verified, we can add them effective back to your benefits start date in some cases.

lucas: where to upload the marriage cert + NIE? I tried the portal > Benefits > Dependents and got an upload error (timeout).

hr-bot: Upload helper: Please use People Ops portal > Benefits > Dependents. Accepted: pdf/png/jpg. Max 8MB. If upload fails, attach the files in this thread and tag @alejandra-peopleops. Do not paste sensitive IDs in channel messages.

alejandra-peopleops: if portal times out, please attach here and i'll move to secure intake. include partner full name and fecha de nacimiento in filename.

lucas: thanks. second question: relocation receipts  I used Expense > Relocation and selected "standard reimbursement". Is that a separate run? I need to plan for cash flow.

marco-payroll: hey Lucas  reimbursement batches are separate from monthly payroll by default. approved relocation claims are paid on the next reimbursement cycle (usually within 2 payroll cycles). if you need faster, mark as "expedite" in the expense form and cc payroll; we can sometimes include it in the next payroll but it depends on cutoff.

lucas: what are the payroll cutoffs? i started 4/07 and want to know if salary for April will be pro-rated and when it posts.

marco-payroll: monthly payroll cutoff is the 20th for that month's payment (payday last business day). salary is prorated by calendar days based on contract FTE. for a 4/07 start, you'll get pro-rated April salary on 4/30. reimbursements separate unless expedited.

lucas: good to know. last Q: PTO  how is holiday accrual handled for Spain mid-month starts?

alejandra-peopleops: standard: annual vacation days are pro-rated by month for new joins. example: 24 days/year at 1.0 FTE => 2 days/month. terminate/leave months follow policy in contract. if you have special clause, share contract and we'll confirm exact days.

lucas: attaching marriage_cert.pdf (2.1MB) and NIE_photo.jpg (1.2MB) here to avoid portal. please confirm once ingested.

alejandra-peopleops: received attachments, moving to secure intake now. we'll confirm when SS registration is requested and when partner can be added. cc @marco-payroll for reimbursement timing. welcome aboard! :tada:
